decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application would improve the visual appearance of the house and help restore the historic appearance of the listed property so that it makes a stronger more positive impact on the character of the street and the conservation area as a whole, and would also comply with the aims of policies Env-B.1.1, Env-B.2.2 Env-B.2.5 and Env-B.2.7, whilst at the same time providing extensions that are compatible and complementary to the dwelling, without compromising neighbouring amenity and compatible with the aims of Policy H.6.4.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The window formed to the new bathroom in the southern elevation and the three new windows in the northern elevation shall be stained or otherwise obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of part two storey, part single storey rear extension, incorporating new roof terrace on first floor with balustrade and erection of single storey side extension new pitched roof to existing garage, installation of three new windows to side elevation on ground and first floor levels, replacement of rear windows and rooflight, replacement of all tile hanging and roof covering, erection of new front boundary fencing and double gates, internal and external alterations to house.
